Customer Support & Escalation Policy
This policy outlines how support requests are handled for orders, payments, returns, and technical
issues on the IISc Alumni Store.
Q: What's the fastest way to get help?
A: Ask the in-app AI assistant — it can track orders, explain policies, and raise a support ticket for
anything it can't resolve directly.
Q: What are your support hours for a human agent?
A: Monday–Friday, 10:00–18:00 IST. Outside these hours, the AI assistant remains available and
queues tickets for the next business day.
Q: How are support tickets prioritised?
A: P1 – Critical (site down, payment failures): 30-minute initial response, 4-hour resolution target. P2 –
High (order/refund errors): 2-hour response, 1 business day. P3 – Medium (individual return/exchange
issues): 4-hour response, 3 business days. P4 – Low (general questions): 1 business day response, 5
business days resolution.

Q: How do I escalate an unresolved issue?

Q: How can I contact support directly?

Shipping & Delivery Policy
This policy covers order processing, delivery timelines, and tracking for the IISc Alumni Store.
Q: Where do you currently ship?
A: Within India only. International shipping for select items is planned for later this year.
Q: How long does processing take before an order ships?
A: Orders are processed within 1–2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on
weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.
Q: How long does delivery take?
A: Metro cities: 3–5 business days. Rest of India: 5–8 business days.
Q: How much does shipping cost?
A: Shipping cost is calculated at checkout based on package weight and destination. Occasional
free-shipping promotions are announced on the storefront.
Q: How can I track my order?
A: Once shipped, you receive a tracking number by email; orders can also be tracked from the Orders
page in your account.
Q: What if my order is delayed or lost?

Q: How can I track my order?
A: Once shipped, you receive a tracking number by email; orders can also be tracked from the Orders
page in your account.
Q: What if my order is delayed or lost?
A: Contact support (via the AI assistant or store@alumni.iisc.ac.in) within 7 days of the expected
delivery date.
Q: What if my order arrives damaged?
A: Report damaged items within 48 hours of receipt, with photos, so we can arrange a replacement or
refund.
Q: Do you deliver to P.O. Boxes or APO/FPO addresses?
A: No. Since shipping is currently India-only via courier partners, we are unable to deliver to P.O.
Boxes or APO/FPO addresses.

Privacy Policy
This policy explains how the IISc Alumni Store collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
Note: this is a capstone demonstration project — the product catalogue, orders, and checkout are
mocked, and no real payments are processed.
Q: What personal information do you collect?
A: Your name, alumni/student/staff email, shipping address, and order history, plus basic usage data
(pages visited, chatbot interactions) to improve the storefront.
Q: Why do you ask for my alumni email specifically?
A: To verify eligibility for alumni member pricing and reward points — the store is open to IISc alumni,
current students, faculty, and staff.
Q: How do you use my information?
A: To fulfil orders, calculate reward points, personalise recommendations through the AI assistant, and
report aggregate (non-identifying) sales figures for scholarship and heritage-restoration funding.
Q: Do you sell my personal data?
A: No. We never sell personal information to third parties.

Return & Refund Policy
This policy explains how returns, exchanges, and refunds work for orders placed through the IISc
Alumni Store, the official Institute merchandise storefront (Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
560012).
Q: What is your return policy?
A: Unused items in their original packaging with tags attached can be returned within 14 days of
delivery for a refund, store credit, or exchange.
Q: How long is the return window?
A: 14 days from the date of delivery. Returns requested after 14 days cannot be accepted.
Q: Which items are eligible for return?
A: Unused items in original packaging with tags attached. Not eligible: personalised or custom
merchandise, opened software/digital downloads, and clearance or final-sale items.
Q: How long do refunds take?
A: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–7 business days after we receive the
returned item.
Q: Who pays for return shipping?

Q: How long do refunds take?
A: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–7 business days after we receive the
returned item.
Q: Who pays for return shipping?
A: Defective or incorrectly shipped items: the IISc Alumni Store covers return shipping. Change-of-mind
returns: the customer covers return shipping.
Q: How do I start a return?
A: Ask the AI assistant to raise a return request, or email store@alumni.iisc.ac.in. You will receive a
Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) and step-by-step instructions.
Q: Can I exchange an item instead of returning it?
A: Yes. Exchanges for a different size or colour are available within the same 14-day window, subject
to stock availability.
Q: What happens to reward points earned on a returned order?
A: Reward points credited for a returned order are reversed once the refund is processed.

Fraud Prevention Policy
This policy explains how the IISc Alumni Store protects against fraudulent transactions and misuse of
alumni member pricing and reward points.
Q: How do you verify alumni eligibility for member pricing?
A: Member pricing and reward points require sign-in with a verified alumni, student, faculty, or staff
email.
Q: What measures prevent payment fraud?
A: CVV verification on every card payment, 3D Secure authentication, and address verification (AVS)
for billing and shipping details.
Q: How do you handle suspicious reward-points activity?
A: Accounts are monitored for abuse patterns such as multiple accounts from the same device claiming
member pricing or reward points.
Q: What happens if a transaction is flagged as high-risk?
A: The order is held for manual review by the support team before it ships; the customer is notified and
may be asked to verify their alumni status or payment details.
Q: How do you handle chargebacks and disputes?

may be asked to verify their alumni status or payment details.
Q: How do you handle chargebacks and disputes?
A: We maintain clear, published Return & Refund and Shipping policies, keep proof of delivery and
customer communication logs, and escalate disputed transactions to a fraud analyst for review.
